models.mechanism: The oath singles out recurring time as an accumulating sequence whose succession can make outcomes evident.

activation_trace.assigned_role: supplies the successive temporal field presented as evidence

structural_cues: The oath construction wa-l-ʿaṣr elevates the single definite noun as a witness-like object of attention.
B001 itself couples a broad age with recurring day/night and morning/evening intervals.

abductive_moves.assumption: Successive time can function evidentially because repeated intervals expose what processes produce.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The oath marks time as significant but does not state why; recurrence supplies a mechanism beyond mere duration.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: recurring intervals → accumulated exposure of outcomes
alternatives: The oath may simply magnify time's value.
It may designate one particular time of day rather than recurrence generally.

changed_reading.after: An oath by recurring succession as the medium in which outcomes become visible.

models.ablation: Without the oath syntax, B001 remains only a time label; without B001's recurrence, the evidentiary-sequence reading becomes generic.

models.mechanism: Recurring time is provisionally imagined as a press: its passage compresses what unfolds and extracts a yield that had been latent within it.

activation_trace.assigned_role: turns passage into the pressure that exposes inner contents
names the result produced by temporal pressure

structural_cues: One compact noun bears the temporal, pressing, and extracted-yield branches of the same root.
Its placement alone in an oath permits the root image, rather than an explicit predicate, to carry the mechanism.

abductive_moves.assumption: Repeated temporal passage acts analogically like material pressure and reveals the effective yield of events or lives.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: B001, B002, and B007 supply consecutive roles—duration, operation, result—but the text does not explicitly connect them.
alternatives: B002 and B007 may be unrelated lexical branches with no activation here.
Time may consume rather than extract or disclose anything.

changed_reading.after: Time presses what occurs within it until its hidden yield is disclosed.

minimal_triggers: the oath's isolated focus on al-ʿaṣr
models.ablation: Removing B002 collapses the press mechanism; removing B007 leaves pressure without a yield, reducing the reading to a loose metaphor.

surprise_reading: At baseline, the oath can invoke recurring time as accumulated evidence; more speculatively, the root leaves dormant an image of time pressing events until their hidden yield appears.
